name: tech.aspid.collections
description: A set of covariate observation collections with easy synchronization between two collections, filtering and sorting.

samples.description: Hello-world for ObservableList<T>. Walks through single-item vs batch forms of NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs<T>, the custom struct event args, and the Action switch.
Projects an ObservableList<InventoryItem> POCO model into an Observable*Sync<InventoryItem, InventoryItemView> view via CreateSync, with proper Dispose ownership in OnDestroy.
Chains FilteredList<T> wrappers for search + category filtering, and demonstrates the single-thread mutation rule and the Dispose-in-reverse-order discipline.
ObservableDictionary<TKey, TValue> driving a keyed UI table (leaderboard by playerId). Shows per-key Add/Replace/Remove events and exposing an IReadOnlyObservableDictionary projection.
Attaches an analytics/logging tap to an ObservableCollection via SplitByEvents. The returned IObservableEvents<T> handle owns the subscription — Dispose it to unsubscribe.
